sources: Organizer-supplied name, DJ alias, WhatTheStack organising role, biography and portrait

record.bio:
Dina Damjanovikj, known as DinaShantina, is part of the WhatTheStack organising team. For WTS 2026, she's also taking her place behind the decks as our DJ.

She has helped organise BeerJS events, handles logistics with DeveD, and is Logistics Director at Women in Tech Macedonia.

Her own move into tech began with Women in Tech mentoring and a frontend developer academy. At Rigilog in Skopje, her work has spanned frontend development, team leadership and business operations.

Her motto: "Fall seven times, stand up eight."
